G2-PED-01.defect: The foreign-body and pneumonia seeds both read 'or' in their frozen prose and were carried as conjunctions.

G2-PED-02.defect: CLM-R2-PED-VIRAL-INDICATION and CLM-R2-PED-CXR-INDICATION are disjunctive indications carried as conjunctions, so a competitor whose first disjunct the stem states was scored 1 of 2 and treated as defeated.

gate.precommitted_in: section 14.1 of the design, before any V2 result existed

method: The V2 relation model is evaluated against the ten frozen V1 stems exactly as they were written. No stem, option, seed, evidence packet or verdict is changed and no question prose is generated. The only question asked is whether the relation model would have classified the competitors correctly on the material that was actually produced.

Give intravenous furosemide for the raised jugular venous pressure
Give sublingual nitroglycerin for the ischaemic pain

results.v1_reject_reason: Furosemide and sublingual nitroglycerin are eliminated by one and the same preload proposition, so one option slot does no independent work. The paired troponin values have no role in the decision the lead-in asks for in an activated primary-PCI pathway and read as inserted item furniture; they also imply an awkward total ischaemic time.

Two unsupported rationale claims. The packet says an abscess often presents with a palpable collection, which does not license the categorical inverse that no fluctuance excludes a drainable collection, and that sentence would teach a candidate to under-use ultrasound in a lactating woman with a mass. The packet also attaches the stated presentation to inflammatory mastitis and never supplies a criterion for calling it bacterial.

detail.name: ANCHOR_EQUALS_CONDITION
detail.note: every usable plausibility anchor also completes its own correctness signature, so it is live only when it is a second key

results.v1_reject_reason: The keyed answer is arguably wrong. The stem's own facts satisfy the guideline conditions the rationales say are unmet: the cohorting sentence is the cited indication for viral testing, and failure to improve is the cited indication for a radiograph, while the infant meets none of the quoted preconditions for intermittent monitoring. Not repairable by editing rationales.

Length-time bias is a defensible second key. Randomisation excludes healthy-screenee bias but not length bias or overdiagnosis, and the stem supplies no case-mix or case-count data to separate them from lead time, so the rationales exclude two options by asserting facts the stem never states.

competitor_verdicts.concept: Add a statement that participation is voluntary and that declining will not affect any other care
Add the number of cancers the programme detected last year
Add the sensitivity and specificity of the screening test
Launch as planned with continuing evaluation against programme goals
Launch in a single district as a pilot and expand later
Raise the threshold so that fewer results are called positive
A supervised exercise programme as sole initial treatment
Structured psychotherapy such as cognitive behavioural therapy

results.v1_reject_reason: Digitally delivered CBT is a second defensible key. The access barrier the blueprint inserted to defeat in-person psychotherapy is precisely the condition under which digital CBT is indicated, so it strengthens that competitor rather than weakening it, and the stem reports no patient preference, which is the only stated ground for preferring medication.

Pelvic inflammatory disease and tubo-ovarian abscess test the same discrimination, the latter being a complication of the former, and both rationales defeat their option using pelvic examination findings the stem never reports. A lone-category cue is also present: the key is the only non-gynaecologic option.

results.v1_reject_reason: The stem's own findings score Alvarado 7, the high band calling for surgical consultation, while the stem asserts intermediate suspicion and the key depends on the intermediate band; the quoted Alvarado bands overlap at 4; ultrasonography is a defensible second key on the item's own stepwise evidence and is defeated only by a body-habitus fact the stem never gives; MRI and ultrasound-with-KUB have no positive stem anchor; and the pre-declared probability band, the contrast clearance and the availability clause are all present because options need them.

what_v2_does_not_claim: G2-OBGYN-01 is not intercepted and is not counted as a miss. Its single reject-forcing cause was H_OPTION_WORDING_REALIZATION_DEFECT, two rationale claims authored at realization, and the diagnosis established that a perfect option layer would have prevented it. A contrast-relation model has nothing to say about a rationale that polarizes its own cited claim, and V2 correctly passes the item through to the layer that owns the defect.
